tips.title: Copy tool report template folder
tips.body: Copy the OM_REPORT_2 folder from <ADDINS>\hmAutoColor\SYSTEM_PROCESS\Reports\ToolReports to <AUTOMATION>\REPORTS\toolReports\report_templates.

tips.title: Rename template folder
tips.body: Rename the copied OM_REPORT_2 folder to your desired <REPORT_NAME>.

tips.title: Rename template files
tips.body: Rename the following files: Template_OM_REPORT_2.xlsx to Template_<REPORT_NAME>.<LANGUAGE>.xlsx, ToolReport_OM_REPORT_2.xlsx to ToolReport_<REPORT_NAME>.xlsx, and OM_REPORT_2_JL.jpg to <REPORT_NAME>_JL.jpg.

tips.title: Modify template
tips.body: Open Template_<REPORT_NAME>.<LANGUAGE>.xlsx and customize the report as desired.

tips.title: Modify header definition
tips.body: Open ToolReport_<REPORT_NAME>.xlsx, go to the Header tab, and use existing parameters from column B without changing rows or cell addresses.

tips.title: Modify tool definition
tips.body: Open ToolReport_<REPORT_NAME>.xlsx, go to the Tool Part Definition tab, and use existing parameters from column B without changing rows or cell addresses.

tips.title: Final step to run report
tips.body: Start the report configuration and run the report.
